- One full-length mirror photo of what you are wearing
- Four genuinely different directions, side by side
- Named styles: Scandi minimal, quiet luxury, gorpcore, dark academia and more
- Rendered on YOU — your face, your body, your proportions unchanged

- Ask about the layers, the shoes, the palette — or for four new directions

PERFECT FOR:
- Anyone who wants to see a style on themselves before buying it
- People rebuilding a wardrobe and unsure which direction to commit to
- Anyone tired of outfit decision fatigue
- People working out their own aesthetic

record.description_evidence:
Olune is your AI fashion stylist. Take one selfie, type any look, and see yourself wearing it. Then shop the pieces from real stores.

TYPE ANY LOOK
Describe a vibe, an occasion or a place: "black-tie gala in Vienna", "Copenhagen street style", "a coastal weekend in Capri". Olune styles you head to toe in seconds. Blend two ideas to make something new.

SAY THE CHANGE
Tap Remix and type what you want: "make it linen", "add a camel trench", "all black". Same you, same pose, and only that piece changes. Or tap Fresh take for a new version of the look.

SHOP THE PIECES
Every look comes with close matches from real stores, with prices. Save pieces to your cart, email yourself the list, or upload any outfit photo you love to find where to buy it.

MADE FOR YOUR BODY
Set your silhouette, body type, height and sizes once. Your looks and your shopping matches follow them.

YOUR LOOKS, SAVED
Everything you create lives in Your Looks and follows your account to a new phone. Share your favorites in a tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your selfie is used only to style you. It is never posted, never sold and never used to train AI. You can delete your account and data anytime, right in the app.

OLUNE PRO
Start free. Olune Pro unlocks unlimited styling, unlimited remixes, blends and accessory swaps, watermark-free shares, and your whole feed styled on you. Unlimited use is subject to a daily fair-use limit. Choose weekly, monthly or annual.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Olune Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

record.name: AI Fashion Designer Try-On
record.offering: Entertainment app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Got a fashion idea you want to bring to life? Catwalk.AI AI Fashion Designer is for you.

With Catwalk.AI, anyone can be a fashion designer. Simply describe your vision and watch as AI creates a unique, high-quality fashion look right in front of your eyes in under a minute. If you like what you see, you can see how it looks on you or any model in both studio quality photos and videos.

Whether you are imagining a casual outfit for everyday wear, a professional wardrobe for work, or a statement piece for a party, wedding, or red carpet event, Catwalk.AI allows you to create it in seconds. Explore streetwear, luxury looks, evening gowns, vintage pieces, futuristic styles and more. 

The app transforms words into style and gives you the freedom to experiment with shapes, fabrics, colors, and fits before they exist in the real world. The app is a virtual fashion design studio and a personal dressing room combined.

Once you have generated your look, you can try it on instantly. Catwalk.AI supports both still images and moving video, so your style does not stay static. You can see how an outfit looks in motion and experience your vision as if it were already part of your wardrobe. This adds an entirely new layer of realism and creativity, letting you experiment without limits.

Your designs can be saved to a personal digital closet, helping you build a virtual wardrobe that is always with you. You can revisit your looks, mix and match pieces, and refine your style over time. The virtual wardrobe makes it easy to plan new outfits, gather inspiration before shopping, or curate a unique fashion identity that reflects your personality.

Catwalk.AI is designed for everyone. You do not need professional design skills, only your imagination. Fashion lovers can explore their passion, content creators can generate eye-catching looks for photos and videos, stylists can test ideas with clients, and shoppers can preview outfits before buying.

The app also makes it possible to explore global styles and trends. You can design looks influenced by cultures around the world and move beyond fast fashion to create outfits that are truly personal. Sharing your creations with friends or on social media is easy with your own public profile, making Catwalk.AI not only a private design experience but also a way to inspire others.

Catwalk.AI Fashion Designer combines cutting-edge artificial intelligence with the artistry of style. It gives you the power to be your own designer, stylist, and model. From idea to outfit, from imagination to reality, it is your vision and your runway.

What will you design today?

record.description_evidence:
Your personal shopper — for fashion, beauty, home, and more. Styled around you, from the moment you open the app. 
Chat, ask Siri AI, or just open the feed to discover picks made only for you. Discover a shopping feed that feels designed for you. Because it is!
 
Glance is your personal shopper - working behind the scenes to create a deeply personal feed across fashion, beauty, home, and more, built from what you tell it.
From what you wear to how you live

* Fashion & outfits
* Beauty & makeup
* Skincare
* Home decor
* Hairstyles
* Accessories & eyewear

Instead of browsing endless catalogs, you get a curated feed that understands not just you, but the weather around you, what's trending, upcoming occasions, and what visually works for you — whether that's an outfit, a hairstyle, your skincare routine, or how you decorate your home. The best part? Your feed is curated with 'you' at the center of it.
 
What Glance does

* Builds a personal feed of collections you can shop — across fashion, beauty, home, and more
* Curates moodboards that suit your aesthetic
* Understands you and the context around you — weather, trends, occasions, and what you tell it
* Generates styled try-ons entirely on your device — as fast as 30 seconds, unlimited, and free
* Lets you add a photo anytime to see yourself in it — editorial-quality, starring you
* Refines your picks in real-time, the more you chat or interact
* Answers you through Siri AI too -- "Hey Siri, Let's Glance"

What makes this different

* A personal shopper that actually knows you — not just your preferences
* Real-time awareness of weather, trends, occasions, and your style
* Reachable anywhere -- in the app, in chat, or just by asking Siri AI
* Styled entirely on your device -- unlimited try-ons, in seconds, at no extra cost
* Complete shoppable picks, not isolated product suggestions
* Across fashion, beauty, home, and more -- one shopper for everything you need styled
* Editorial-quality visuals organized into relevant collections starring you

Every feed is unique to your combination of location, timing, and personal attributes. The same person gets a different feed across seasons or cities.
What you can do with your feed and chat

* Explore picks designed specifically for you
* Understand what colors, styles, and choices work best for you
* Chat to refine your style, ask for something specific, or explore a new idea
* Ask Siri AI for a pick, directly — no need to open Glance
* Shop from these collections
* Share with friends, family, or stylists

This isn't generic personalization. This is a personal shopper designed to understand context, timing, and - most of all — you.
